Text: i purchased these instead of the senseo pods based on others' positive reviews. unfortunately, one pod makes one small cup of weak coffee. the pods are larger than the senseo pods, so i can't use two to make a decent cup of coffee. very disappointed. should have stayed with senseo.

i'm used to cheap tea (by the way, cheap tea isn't low quality), but this one's awful. it tastes like very spicy water.. water with tabasco added, essentially. although i did steep the tea bag for about four minutes, there was no depth to the flavor. i finished the cup, but i certainly wouldn't buy it.
item is fine. it is just over priced. buy smaller quantity at cheaper price at target. cannot return. save your money

i ordered sprouting mix clover, alfalfa, fenugreek, and radish, 16 ounce bags (pack of 4) but the none of the packet has alfalfa seeds, even in the back of the packet ingredient: crimson clover + fenugreek + radish seeds only.. so there is no alfalfa seed in the packet, i see only 3 types of seeds...this is bad selling..

the product description says 128 ounces aka 1 gallon. the image, if enlarged shows a 1 litter bottle. the actual product sent out is the 1 liter bottle. major difference than the product description. at least it tastes pretty darn good.

other reviewers are right on. this is a very good blend of flavors and this container size will last for a long time. i have also thrown it in the freezer and found it keeps just fine and will not freeze solid, so you can just take the amount you need when you need it. by far my favorite curry paste!

my foster doxies gobbled this food right up. it arrived at the perfect time for one of them; he had been picking at his regular food and generally not feeling well, we found out he was having problems with a tooth and this softer dog food was perfect for him. now that he's better, he still prefers it. i was happy that the first ingredient was beef, not beef by-product. my only concern is that it has food dyes, red 40 and more, i know that there are organic vegetable dyes like beet juice that might be better for them. they've eaten half a bag in the last 2 weeks and no adverse effects. good job chef michael.

not only is this snack delicious but it's one of the first items to be even better than regular pretzels that have wheat. the recipe produces a light and very crispy pretzel, doesn't get stale after leaving it a month in ziploc like other pretzels. everyone that i've shared with agrees with me. so it is very expensive though for those who cannot eat gluten, it's a must have. i buy it by the case and sparingly share with others!

the plant i received shipped very fast. it arrived in a little plastic bag to keep everything moist which was nice...i planted it in a large mason jar with a venus flytrap and a pitcher plant. the plant is growing fine and i am very satisfied with the speedy shipment. i would be careful with following the growing instructions from some other users. all carnivorous plants need some sort of humidity which would be sealing it in some sort of container with a few holes on the top and i would be careful of placing these plants in direct sunlight, the plants will barely produce or stop producing the sticky dew drops in both cases.
very good pocky, especially for the price. it kind of bothered me that it had trans fat in it though.
